originality.rationale: TARGET route: audited against admitted target with no value presumption. Live fused search (SerpBase+Serpent+Crossref, no partial failure) retrieved the nearest priors and each was compared literally. Complex relative recursions (Vakil thesis, Cooper Fock-space btran, CJMR arXiv:1706.05401, Ardila-Brugalle double GW) compute complex/logarithmic numbers with no Welschinger signs at section contacts and cannot mechanically yield the signed distribution. Blomme (2025) relative refined recursion concerns Mikhalkin quantum-index refined counts with boundary points, a different invariant/scope, and publishes no F2 E+4F (2)_moving ledger with w->w* section-contact rule. Ding-Hu (2025/2026) refined diagrams relative to a conic concern blow-ups on a conic, not F2 E-tangency. No database or table of relative real F2 invariants with signs containing 12/8 was found. The exact signed edge-splitting with even-weight vanishing is therefore new and not implied, recomputed, or renamed.
